additionalInformation: The item's internal name is bfury
description: The bearer of this mighty axe gains the ability to cut down swaths of enemies at once.
trivia: Faceless Void's cosmetic item, Battlefury, is based on Battle Fury.
tips: The Battle Fury is great tool for farming but a poor choice for mid game skirmishes owing to its lack of primary attributes. Avoid it if the enemy team plays aggressively and your presence is required in team fights early. In such cases, it is better to opt for a Maelstrom instead, which provides both early farming and fighting capability, and can later be upgraded into Gleipnir or Mjollnir.
Effective against illusions, summoned units, jungle stacks, ancient stacks and mega creeps.
The cleave benefits from critical hits, including those from items and ignores evasion.
Having Battle Fury can help greatly against an enemy Nature's Prophet, since some carries have little means to escape his Sprout without it (the most obvious being Juggernaut and Troll Warlord)
Melee heroes with high attack speed can push far more effectively with Battle Fury, even in late game. Critical hits help too.
recommendedFor: Anti-Mage needs Battle Fury to farm, since he is terrible without items and has trouble farming fast without it. Combined with Blink, he can flash-farm the jungle and quickly build his much needed items if not ganked
Juggernaut can farm very quickly with it when combined with his low base attack time and Blade Dance crits
Tricks of the Trade is Riki's main source of damage. Battle Fury helps to deal more damage in the 450 radius Tricks of the Trade provides. It also helps Riki farm his items more quickly
Battle Fury allows Phantom Assassin to flash-farm and provides her with major cleave damage during teamfights thanks to Coup de Grace

notes: Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
If multiple sources of Cleave are present, each Cleave's damage is applied separately.

abilities.description: Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 10 for melee heroes, and 5 for ranged.
Deals 60% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to 650 around the target. Deals 40% against creeps. (Melee Only)

name: Battle Fury
